answer.rationale: memory_57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue from established customers with no measurable retention harm, supporting both revenue quality and sustainability. memory_73 directly reports acquisition and revenue lift, but its applicability is limited to price-sensitive SMBs and it omits retention or longer-term economics. memory_44 supports qualified pipeline through enterprise sales-assisted conversion, though it reports pipeline quality rather than realized, durable revenue. memory_31 shows a durable activation lift, making it relevant as a leading indicator, but it omits qualified revenue, retention, and downstream monetization. memory_86 supports adoption through improved onboarding completion and time-to-value, but provides no direct evidence of revenue quality or durability. memory_91 is weakest because it only reports improved week-one engagement and a nudge toward first meaningful action, without evidence of qualified revenue, retention, or durable business impact.
